stretch end B1b-09: orders 183 (shield) to 214 (smite), 32 rooms, about 1.03 MB, as declared. Every room read whole through b1_room.py, every theme with every concept label, before any of its placements; large rooms printed to TMPDIR in parts under 30 KB with the line count checked (romania, TransFlagPlace, mexico and smite in three parts, rangers and furry_irl in two). 329 second-order themes read, 325 placed with 544 placements, 4 unplaced (orderofthebluecorner t11, rangers t15, mexico t19, smite t11). Two new kinds: T3-174 professing loyalty to a colour faction (orderofthebluecorner, order 196) and T3-175 adopting a sign others began (furry_irl, order 206; mexico's Yoshi its second room). Ideas logged and not minted: hijacking a rival's script (detroitlions), calling from comments when the sub's posts are closed (ontario), making a mark because rivals have one (baylor). Episodes E086 to E118, 33 lines, two with more than two rooms (E112, Starry Night in nine rooms; E114, Mexico's flag in five). 219 rule 0 lines and 66 bags. Scheme 175 themes over 2,479 placed second-order themes, 3,679 placements; largest T3-009 (145, 5.8%), T3-010 (134), T3-001 (113), T3-017 (106), T3-002 (105), T3-005 (104), none near one in ten; 874 multiply placed, 326 three times, none over three. validate B1: 0 errors, warnings capped at 200. Stopping rule: 214 of 705 rooms, 29.8% of the words, kinds 179, coverage 0.9917, unseen 26.16; round 5 ended with T3-174 at 196.0 average rooms, T3-175 at order 206 reset the count again, next kind predicted in 7.4 average rooms, no markers. Method change: mem.py codes --grep prints only its first 80 matches, so from ontario on ties were found by room count and each tied room's concepts paged in full; the stretch's earlier rooms were re-checked the same way, finding E111 and E112
